draft.title: Reflecting on your own style
card: Style is the pattern of choices you make as a writer. It includes the words you pick, how long your sentences are, your tone and the techniques you reach for.
To notice your style, reread your own work and ask what you do often. You might open with a question, write mostly short sentences or lean on the same linking words.
Then ask what works. A choice works when it helps a reader feel or understand what you meant. A choice you repeat without thinking can become a habit that dulls your writing.
Finish by setting a goal. Pick one new technique or form to try, such as a flashback or a speech, and say where you will use it in your next piece.
draft.remember: Notice your choices, judge which ones work, then set one goal to try something new.

a.q: Which action is an example of reflecting on your own style?
opts: Noticing that most of your stories open with dialogue
Fixing the spelling mistakes in a finished draft
Asking a friend to choose a topic for you
Copying a published author's first paragraph
a.why: Reflecting on style means noticing the choices you repeat as a writer. Spotting that your stories often open with dialogue does this. Fixing spelling is editing a single draft, not noticing a pattern in your choices.
a.clue: Which one is about a pattern in your own choices?

b.q: Priya notices that her last three stories all end with a short, sharp sentence, and readers say the endings feel powerful. What is the best next step in reflecting on her style?
opts: Set a goal to try a new technique, such as a flashback
Use a short, sharp ending in every piece from now on
Stop using short sentences so her writing is varied
Decide her style is finished and needs no goal
b.why: Priya has noticed a choice and judged that it works. The next step is to set a goal to try something new, such as a flashback. Using the same ending every time is the repeated habit that can dull writing.
b.clue: The last step on the card is about trying something new.

a.best: Noticing that most of your stories open with dialogue

b.best: Set a goal to try a new technique, such as a flashback
